Hi, I'm Peter Bhat Harkins, a programmer and entrepreneur from Chicago. From June 2014 to winter of 2015 I typically posted a dozen stories per day to help the site reach a critical mass of regular visitors. In October 2017 I became the site administrator after the site creator @jcs stepped down. I love hosting this party.

I stream office hours and development on Monday afternoons and Thursday mornings. The stream is on Twitch and archive is on my blog.

Get in touch!

  • Please don’t message me for an invitation if we're complete strangers; check the user list or users who’ve linked their Mastodon accounts for someone you know or ask in chat.
  • Submit a meta post for feature requests (including new tags) to let the community discuss. Bug reports and "is this a bug?" should go to the issue tracker.
  • Message me for administrative and moderator things. I don't see everything and I gotta sleep sometime, so I do appreciate “hey this seems bad” or “what’s up with this?” notes.
  • E-mail my first name @push.cx regarding site security, if you can't log in to message me, or for anything else. If I've posted or commented about something here or in the chat room, I'd almost certainly love to talk more about it.
